observation: Builder src/render/opticCellPresentation.js. Diamond uses the shared cached octahedral shard from opticCellGeometry('diamond') (lines 111-126, key 'optic:prism'); it deliberately does not pay for an astDisplacedGeometry build because visualFactory.js:2647 short-circuits the left side. Body material is the single cached 'optic:body:diamond' MeshPhysicalMaterial (lines 177-210, 258), using the environment-alpha transmission budget with transmission forced to 0, opacity 0.70, transparent, depthWrite false. Detail dressing adds 5 shared octahedron inclusions (geometry cached line 303-304, material cached lines 265-277, 294) per cell, riding the body so they tumble inside the glass (313-336). Role is deliberately distinct: live prism vs stone absorber/metal mirror/spent dead prism (module header 6-20). LOD: body geometry has no LOD swap; greeble-tagged inclusions are hidden at lod2 by hlod.js:14-19/23-60 through buildAsteroid's updateLod hook (visualFactory.js:2745-2750). No per-cell material compile: _opticGeo/_opticMat caches (41-54) and test/optic-materials.test.mjs:141-146 assert two live prisms share one material.
decision: No construction change recommended; the body, material, and facet families are cached and shared, and per-cell inclusions are the only per-instance meshes. Recommend needs follow-up: visual evidence is the acceptance path and no current gameplay capture exists.
next: Needs a current gameplay-scale and close capture (sector_ceres_belt prism gallery or a swarm optic-arena round) plus a measured draw cost; static reuse alone does not establish prism read or speed.
